title: trema virgatum var. pubigerum
intro: Trema virgatum var. pubigerum, commonly known as the False Nettle or Cat's Claw Creeper, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Cannabaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, and it is known for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and improve digestive health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
